source.version: Part 17 — Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation — Batch 04
source.publicationAuthorization: Not yet authorized for publication. This release candidate intentionally remains blocked while independent/external review is pending.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-336–340 have been re-reviewed against current Cornell IPM, U.S. EPA, FDA CAPA, and USDA APHIS greenhouse-system sources as applicable. Scope limits distinguish general IPM/quality-system principles from Cannabis-specific regulation or universal performance standards.
source.note: This batch completes the canonical Part 17 lesson sequence with biological controls, pesticide law and resistance-management literacy, isolation/removal/waste handling, CAPA, and IPM program audit/continuous improvement.
